name: com.aidancmays.chromolithograph
description: A URP renderer feature that prints the frame as a 19th-century chromolithograph: the image is separated into up to eight flat inks laid stone by stone on paper, with grain, hatching, key lines, wash, paper foxing, per-object print styles, and an optional corruption layer.

samples.description: An unlit shader with ChromoHints and ChromoMotion passes, and a component that gives it a print style id.
Drives the print's sky colours and sun direction from the scene's sun light and two colours, for projects without their own sky system.
